name: @clapp/repair
description: CLAPP autonomous repair loop (CLAPP-042): consumes diff-contract v0.1 MIRROR-shaped DiffReports (canonical owner @clapp/diff, CLAPP-040 — never the diff packages themselves), clusters critical/major findings into scoped RepairDirectives, applies bounded evidence-driven edits (text-restore / attribute-restore / mock-restore) to the candidate app's files as git commits with hard scope enforcement, and iterates against a re-run oracle within a max-iterations budget — the loop never reads the SynthesisPlan.
